# EZLONG

> EZLONG (ezlong.com) is a free, no-signup toolbox for long-term US stock investors, built by an individual Korean investor. It offers AI-powered market signals, chart analysis, and a suite of calculators/simulators for DCA (dollar-cost averaging), compounding, retirement planning, and tax-advantaged accounts. Korean is the primary language; an English version lives under /en/.

Data updates: market signals refresh every 30 minutes on US trading days, AI chart analysis hourly, and the positive-vs-negative market scorecard eight times daily. All analysis text is diagnostic (no imperative "buy now" advice).

## Tools (Korean)

- [스윙 시그널 대시보드](https://ezlong.com/atmr-dashboard.html): AI swing-trading signal for QQQ/VOO/SOXX with buy/sell scores, 3-3-4 split-entry strategy guide, and TSLA·NVDA focused analysis
- [긍정 vs 부정 몇대몇](https://ezlong.com/market-vs.html): AI market scorecard — positive vs negative factors ratio, updated 8x daily
- [AI 차트분석](https://ezlong.com/chart-analysis.html): technical chart analysis (RSI, MACD, Bollinger) for 50+ US stocks, ETFs, and crypto
- [월가 목표주가](https://ezlong.com/analyst-reports.html): Wall Street analyst target price consensus for major tech stocks
- [마켓 사이클](https://ezlong.com/market-cycle.html): weekly-candle market cycle monitor for downtrend inflection detection
- [심플 주가](https://ezlong.com/stocks.html): simple real-time price board for 200+ US tickers
- [DCA 시뮬레이터](https://ezlong.com/dca-simulator.html): dollar-cost averaging compound return simulator
- [백테스트](https://ezlong.com/backtest.html): Monte Carlo portfolio simulator
- [은퇴 계산기](https://ezlong.com/retirement-calculator.html): retirement goal reverse calculator
- [절세 계좌](https://ezlong.com/tax-account-simulator.html): Korean tax-advantaged account (ISA/연금저축/IRP) after-tax simulator
- [복리 계산기](https://ezlong.com/compound-calculator.html): compound interest calculator
- [오늘의 차트](https://ezlong.com/today-chart.html): AI technical analysis for SOXX, QQQ, SOXL, TQQQ, TSLA, NVDA, refreshed through the day
- [AI 포트폴리오 점검](https://ezlong.com/model-portfolio.html): weekly technical verdict and weights for a 26-stock model portfolio
- [투자 행동 자가진단](https://ezlong.com/risk-diagnostic.html): free 3-minute self-assessment of investment behavior biases (FOMO, panic selling, overtrading)
- [투자유형 진단](https://ezlong.com/stock-personality-quiz.html): investor personality quiz matching one of 40 US stock portfolio allocations
- [DC·IRP 리밸런싱 계산기](https://ezlong.com/dc-rebalance.html): calculates per-holding sell quantities to meet Korea's 30% safe-asset rule in DC/IRP pension accounts
- [자동 적립 설정 가이드](https://ezlong.com/auto-dca-guide.html): how to set up automatic monthly US stock purchases with Korean brokers
- [그날 무슨 일이](https://ezlong.com/brief-history.html): timeline of major US market events
- [투자 인사이트 게시판](https://ezlong.com/board.html): community board for long-term US stock investing insights

## Other languages

Most tools and articles are available in five more languages. Each page links its translations via hreflang.

- [English](https://ezlong.com/en/): all major tools under /en/
- [日本語](https://ezlong.com/ja/): Japanese versions under /ja/
- [Español](https://ezlong.com/es/): Spanish versions under /es/
- [Português](https://ezlong.com/pt/): Portuguese versions under /pt/
- [中文](https://ezlong.com/zh/): Chinese versions under /zh/
